description: This source file contains implementation of commit reachability algorithms, including functions for computing merge bases, checking descendant relationships, pruning redundant commits, and analyzing commit reachability within a repository. It appears to be part of a version control system's core logic for commit graph analysis.

classes.name: contains_stack
classes.description: Helper structure implementing a stack to traverse commit graph for contains tests, managing commit pointers and their parent lists.

classes.name: commit_and_index
classes.description: Structure holding a commit pointer along with its generation and index, used in sorting and traversal algorithms.

classes.name: best_branch_base
classes.description: Cache slab structure initialized and used for tracking best branch base commits during traversal.

methods.name: int compare_commits_by_gen(const void * _a,const void * _b)
methods.description: Compare two commits based on their graph generation, used for sorting commits.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases_many_0
methods.description: Helper function to find merge bases among multiple commits with flexible cleanup options.

methods.name: enum:contains_result contains_test(struct commit * candidate,const struct commit_list * want,struct contains_cache * cache,timestamp_t cutoff)
methods.description: Performs a test if a commit is contained in a commit list, possibly recursing through parents.

methods.name: void push_to_contains_stack(struct commit * candidate,struct contains_stack * contains_stack)
methods.description: Pushes a commit and its parents onto the contains stack for traversal.

methods.name: enum:contains_result contains_tag_algo(struct commit * candidate,const struct commit_list * want,struct contains_cache * cache)
methods.description: Checks if a commit contains any of a set of target commits using a stack-based algorithm.

methods.name: get_best
methods.description: Retrieves the 'best' marker from the best_branch_base slab for a given commit.

methods.name: set_best
methods.description: Sets the 'best' marker in the best_branch_base slab for a given commit.
